title: Geometric Kummer Chern equation for the positive residue Cartier class
statement: For prime l, noetherian Y, P¹_Y and diagonal surface, l invertible on Y and n≥0, the class cartierResidueReducedPro for the diagonal at exponent n+1 satisfies GeoCartierChernEquation [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface]: after forgetting support it is the site-comparison image of an ordinary etale finite class whose integral adjunct equals supportedKummerChern of the diagonal. The class and all comparison maps are the fixed canonical residue constructions [lem-sp-cartier-reduction-site-comparison].

source.place: paragraph (2), finite Cartier normalization and forget supports, before the divisor line is decomposed; diagonal-limit clause (3), and classes proof (3)

proof.text: The ring Z/l^(n+1) is finite because l is prime and n+1>0. Apply cartier_reduction_site_comparison with this ring and the diagonal immersion and take its geometric Chern clause. That clause is proved by Cartier reduction uniqueness, comparison with the ordinary supported Kummer class and supported Kummer Chern realization. Unfold only cartierResidueReducedPro to identify the named residue class.
